_comment: Baseline of currently-known unresolved tool-pointer instruments, keyed by instrument name. sc_pointer_validation.ts treats any unresolved pointer whose instrument is in this list as QUARANTINED (pre-existing, tracked); any unresolved pointer NOT in this list is a genuinely NEW regression and fails CI. Entries tagged 'register_row' with an SC-N id were already filed in MARSYS_DEFECT_GAP_REGISTER_v2_0.md; entries tagged with a NEW-P-n id were discovered by this harness on 2026-07-10 and are NOT yet filed — recommend the owning lane add them to the register (Phase 3e / SC-family) before closing this baseline entry. Ring-2 review (post-bacade1c) caught that collectRegisteredTools() originally missed the regAlias()/globalAlias() indirection in register_p1_aliases.ts, producing two FALSE POSITIVES here (phala_predictive_anchors_get — registered via regAlias at register_p1_aliases.ts:416; bodha_remedies_get — registered via regAlias at register_p1_aliases.ts:393). Both were removed once lib/mcp_registered_tools.ts was fixed to resolve regAlias/globalAlias call sites; the remaining NEW-P1/P2 entries were re-confirmed as genuinely unresolved after the fix.
